sections.title: The letter kú
paragraphs: The letter name is (kú) /kuː/. Its main sound is heard in (quasi) /ˈkvɒzi/, which means as if. The letter makes only one sound.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Block the air flow completely. Release the tongue sharply so the air bursts out. Keep your vocal cords still. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: The letter appears only in borrowed words and names. It always comes before the letter u. You say it as a sound in (Aquincum) /ˈɒkviŋkum/.

sections.title: Tips for English
paragraphs: In English you often add a small puff of air after this sound. In Hungarian you must stop that puff. Say the sound crisply without extra air, just like the sound in scan.
